name: internal release note goes to the team Slack channel

acceptance: one Slack message for the internal audience

expect: the message is rendered from the generic Slack template, with no leftover placeholder
one comms.send action, to the internal channel listed in channels.yaml (run with PMOS_CHANNELS_FILE set to the fixture)
every action has an idempotency key and a preview equal to its rendered text
status needs_approval; no message was sent
